units.source_text: 修学院离宫、御所的松林，古寺那宽广庭园里的树木自不消说，在市内木屋町和高濑川畔、五条和护城河边的垂柳，都吸引着游客。

en.t: Needless to say, the pine groves of Shugakuin Imperial Villa and the Imperial Palace, and the trees in the broad gardens of old temples, attracted visitors; so too did the weeping willows along Kiyamachi and the Takase River in the city, and by Gojo and the moat.

units.source_text: 那是真正的垂柳，翠绿的枝条几乎垂到地面，婀娜轻盈。

en.t: They were true weeping willows, with green branches hanging almost to the ground, graceful and light.

units.source_text: 还有那北山的赤松，绵亘不绝，细柔柔地形成一个圆形，也给人同样的美的享受。

en.t: And the red pines of Kitayama, stretching on without end and softly forming a rounded shape with their slender delicacy, gave the same enjoyment of beauty.
